evidence.stated_reason: Globavend Holdings Limited (“Registrant”) was unable, without unreasonable effort or expense, to file its Form 20-F for the financial year ended September 30, 2025 (the “Annual Report”) by the filing due date. The Company is experiencing a delay in receiving confirmations from its bank account in China necessary to finalize the consolidated balance sheets. As a result, the Registrant is still in the process of compiling required information to complete the Annual Report. The Registrant anticipates that it will file the Annual Report no later than the fifteenth calendar day following the prescribed filing date.
evidence.why: The company told the SEC it could not file a periodic report on time, using Form 12b-25.

headline: Globavend Holdings Ltd told the SEC it could not file its annual report on time
label: Late filing
quote: Globavend Holdings Limited (“Registrant”) was unable, without unreasonable effort or expense, to file its Form 20-F for the financial year ended September 30, 2025 (the “Annual Report”) by the filing due date. The Company is experiencing a delay in receiving confirmations from its bank account in China necessary to finalize the consolidated balance sheets. As a result, the Registrant is still in the process of compiling required information to complete the Annual Report. The Registrant anticipates that it will file the Annual Report no later than the fifteenth calendar day following the prescribed filing date.
